# #1522: strict scope terminator may not be strict enough for some usecases

- **URL:** https://github.com/endojs/endo/issues/1522
- **State:** OPEN
- **Author:** @naugtur
- **Created:** 2023-03-22T11:53:14Z
- **Updated:** 2024-01-10T00:06:44Z
- **Labels:** `kriskowal-reviewed-2024-01`

## Description

When considering strictScopeTerminator being used outside of the evaluator built into SES - eg. in the secure bundling with webpack usecase we're now exploring - an option to return true strictly always in the `has` trap seems necessary 
https://github.com/endojs/endo/blob/master/packages/ses/src/strict-scope-terminator.js#L51

Particularly when the `with` blocks get inlined inside scopes containing powerful non-lobal references (like `__webpack_require__`)
